interface.name: qindaqt_window_manager_v1
interface.description: This optional interface places an application's newly created normal toplevel beside another toplevel owned by the same Wayland connection. Applications own content, window creation and shortcut handling. The compositor owns eligibility, topology, atomic publication and focus. Requests require a foreground source, expire after five seconds while waiting for mapping, and never mutate topology on rejection or cancellation. Unsupported compositors do not advertise this global; applications retain ordinary windows and normal shortcut behavior. See the installed QindaQt application-window-management documentation for the complete contract.

request.name: place

description.summary: place a new independent window atomically

request.description: request_id is nonzero and unique among this object's pending requests. source and created must be distinct normal toplevel surfaces owned by this object's client. The source must already be managed. The created surface may be awaiting mapping but must become a managed independent window before the deadline. Tab inserts after the source page and activates the new page in the same transaction. Tile splits the source leaf equally. A solo source creates a new container. The source or new window must remain foreground when the request commits. The compositor sends exactly one result unless this object or client is destroyed. A rejected or cancelled created window stays an ordinary application window; the compositor never closes it.
